### Prerequisites

We suggest you first read the texts about navigating the menus (<htcite0>) and about the menu options (<htcite1>).

### Introduction

At the top-right of every page of History Tracers there is an area with controls and information. It lets you change the language and the calendar, set the break reminders, open the latest addition, and follow the project on social media. This guide describes each of these fields.

### Language

The **Language** field is a list with the languages available: *Português - BR*, *English - USA*, and *Español - ES*. Select one to read the whole site in that language; the page is reloaded with the chosen language.

### Break The **Break** field sets the interval between rest reminders. Choose a value from 15 to 60 minutes. When the time is reached, History Tracers shows a message suggesting that you rest, drink water, or eat something. When you return, click the **I'm back!** button in the message to receive the next reminder later.
You are doing an awesome work! But remember, relax is also part of the learning process. We suggest you to stop few minutes to drink water, go to the bathroom, talk with families, friends and relatives. Eat something before to proceed. When you return, click on "I'm back!" button to ensure you will receive another break reminder in few minutes.

### Latest addition

The **Latest addition** box shows the most recently published content, always the newest on top. Click the name shown there to open that content directly, so you can quickly see what is new on the site.

### Social media

At the top-right, below the other fields, there are the project's social media channels. Click the icons to visit History Tracers on Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, GitHub, and Spotify. There you can also support the project through Patreon, PayPal, or PIX using the QR code.

### Conclusion

The top-right area gives quick access to the language, the calendar, the break reminders, the latest addition, and the social media channels. Use it to adjust the site to your preferences.
